preconditions.description: Input consists of two positive integers n and k where k is strictly less than n and n is at most 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split()) and len(stdin.split()) == 2
preconditions.description: stdin is a single line containing exactly two space-separated positive integers.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.split()) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split()) and len({int(x) for x in stdout.split()}) == n
postconditions.description: stdout is a permutation of length n consisting of distinct integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: len({abs(int(stdout.split()[i]) - int(stdout.split()[i+1])) for i in range(n-1)}) == k
postconditions.description: The set of absolute differences between consecutive elements in the permutation has exactly k distinct values.
